title: Thoughts? When working with AI using game design skill (not ai skill)
author: Maidforblood
selftext:
As a solo game dev. Using ai as a tool has always been useful to cut down time and long process of doing difficult things by hand. My game would never see the light of day,  let alone  showcase a working demo prototype. Despite the use of ai has helped make ideas come to life, i still personally believe game design skillset would be insanely useful to make the game more fun and satisfying to play. I'm currently designing some satisfying  mechanic that would make the player have that dopamine feel when doing a certain action inside the game.

what do you personally think? Do you have the game design skill you can put to good use to polish your game?
